items.title: Sheila Jordan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: my Aunt Esther, she was like my… she was like my big sister.

ctx.x: I have half-sisters and I have a half-brother. Of course, he‟s passed on. But I never really knew them. I knew the two older ones „cause I went to… I was invited to the second eldest‟s… I was invited to her wedding. So I went to her wedding and uh… But that was it. All my uncles and aunts, except for the older ones, were like my brothers and sisters, you know. So uh, as I said, my Aunt Esther, she was like my… she was like my big sister.
So you‟re living at this women‟s rooming house.
